basic_info.description: I run Manny Roy Consulting from Prince Edward Island. That site is the current picture of the work: technical SEO, content systems, automation, and websites built to be maintained. The projects below are the public record, including earlier apps.

projects.title: Manny Roy Consulting
projects.description: The current home of the work. mannyroy.com is where I publish, test content systems, and show how I approach technical SEO, automation, and sites a client can own. The repository is the Ghost theme and the information architecture behind that site.

projects.title: Eastward
projects.description: A guide to Eastern Prince Edward Island: communities, places, and a few ways to plan a trip. I built it as a portfolio project, and the site says so. The inquiry form does not send anything.

projects.title: Canadian AI-Driven RFP Finder
projects.description: A Python CLI for Canadian public-sector tenders. It fetches CanadaBuys notices, keeps a local record of amendments, and scores them against a business profile. When a model helps rank a notice, the reason is still something you can read.

projects.title: WooCommerce to Trexity
projects.description: A WordPress plugin that books a Trexity delivery after an eligible WooCommerce order is paid. It checks the cart and the shipping method, skips orders that were already submitted, and writes the shipment, tracking, or the skip reason back onto the order.

projects.title: Organized Chaos Arts
projects.description: A Next.js and Sanity site for an arts organization I am co-founding. Public pages, a written-down content model, and design tokens, so later membership work has a structure to land in.

projects.title: Hyrule Merchant
projects.description: A noncommercial Hyrule shop and field guide. A snapshot of the compendium API is validated at build time, and the prices, stock, and recipes I invented stay out of the source data. Nothing is actually for sale, and it is not affiliated with Nintendo.

projects.title: WordPress Venue Management
projects.description: A plugin for venues with a public programme: trivia, readings, seasonal dates. Each date is an event, related dates are a series, and a saved rule fills the calendar ahead. Visitors get an archive, an iCal download, and Event structured data.

projects.title: Portfolio (This Website)
projects.description: A personalized React SPA utilizing Bootstrap and JQuery for showing off my achievements and keeping my adoring fans up to date ;) Learning about data modularity was a lot of fun, and taught me the value of thinking modularly from the beginning of a project! (Live: You're here!)

projects.title: Lift Off
projects.description: This is an app quickly built for a demand; my groggy brain ached and my caffeinated brain answered. I grew tired of wasting morning light counting and staring blankly at my fingers atop the Goodlife Fitness platforms, so I created a simple app full of calculators to do the hard work for me. Now I can truly focus on lifting things up then putting them down over and over! (Live in link)

projects.title: Simple Weather
projects.description: The name is apt - a simple weather app that uses the OpenWeatherMap API to display current conditions and a short forecast for a given location (starting with mine!). This was my first time using Vue, so I set a simple goal of handling data and displaying it in a clean, user-friendly way. I'll continue to edit this app as a way to challenge my HTML/CSS skills. (Live in link)

projects.title: Hyrule Compendium
projects.description: A React SPA that features interactive browsing of items found in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. This is app utilizes data from a publically hosted API and a Lambda hosted, Python crafted fuzzysearch function! (Live in link)

projects.title: Petome
projects.description: The most fun I've had creating a web app (so far!). I deepened my understanding of React state, reducers, and hooks, as well as asynchronous data handling throughout this project. I'm proud of the clean, simple interface and the seamlessness of play- but there's still a long way to go with this one! (Live in link)

experience.title: Junior SEO Specialist and Automation Developer
